articles.title: The Incredible Shrinking BP May Be Just What Investors Need
articles.summary: The oil major’s earnings jumped 78% in the latest quarter, but new CEO Meg O’Neill made clear that its future will be about getting smaller by selling parts of its business around the world. O’Neill even said it may be time to stop calling the company a “supermajor” at all. Thanks largely to stronger oil prices and refining margins that have lifted the entire sector, its stock has since matched the Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund’s roughly 27% return this year.
